title: phenax sonneratii
intro: Phenax sonneratii, commonly known as Himalayan pennywort, is a type of medicinal plant native to the Himalayan region. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Phenax sonneratii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
